name: found-power-decline-second-discard-still-draws
notes: Found Power (8pIXnuI1Df): "Empower 3. If you control an object named Proto Key Crest, discard up to two cards, then draw that many cards." Stopping after one discard (declining the 'Discard a card? (Found Power 2/2)' prompt with PASS) must still draw one card for the card already discarded. Regression: FoundPowerDiscard1 queued its paired CUSTOM 'FoundPowerDiscard2' decision without dontSkipOnPass, so ExecuteStaticMethods() skipped the handler when the player answered PASS and its draw step never ran: the first card was discarded and nothing was drawn. Proto Key Crest is seeded onto the field as the condition (not the card under test); Found Power is activated from hand through real actions.

rulesClauses: If you control an object named Proto Key Crest, discard up to two cards, then draw that many cards.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. FoundPowerDiscard1 queued the CUSTOM 'FoundPowerDiscard2' decision without dontSkipOnPass, so declining the second discard (MZMAYCHOOSE answered PASS) made ExecuteStaticMethods() skip the handler and the draw-that-many step never ran: one card was discarded and none drawn. Fix: dontSkipOnPass:1 on that AddDecision.
